answer: Submissions that land within 184 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. The fable detector writes to pearl, and saffron publishes every merge. A farm scripting its whole swarm fires them together, and therefore the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 119 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
